title: Malik Willis: Familiarity with Jeff Hafley, Jon-Eric Sullivan led to picking Miami

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Malik Willis: Familiarity with Jeff Hafley, Jon-Eric Sullivan led to picking Miami
sources.description: Willis said it didn't take long to decide, because of his relationship with new Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley and G.M. Jon-Eric Sullivan.
